title: Rescue from Wrath
definition: Rescue from Wrath is God's deliverance of believers from deserved judgment through the saving work of Christ.
summary: Rescue from Wrath teaches that Christ delivers believers from the righteous judgment their sins deserve.
christFocus: Jesus Christ bore judgment at the cross and rescues believers from condemnation.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Rescue from wrath highlights the danger from which salvation saves us. The Gospel is not only help for a difficult life; it is deliverance from coming judgment through Jesus. This doctrine brings urgency to evangelism and deep gratitude to worship.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because a cross without wrath becomes sentimental, and warning without Christ becomes hopeless. Scripture holds both together: wrath is real, and rescue is offered in the Son. The doctrine keeps the Church awake to eternity.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Let the reality of judgment sober your heart without stealing your joy in Christ. Pray for the lost with urgency. Speak of salvation as rescue, not merely improvement or inspiration.
